Maria (PM): Quick sync — planning design partner recruitment for the Private/Dedicated beta. Goal: 8–12 partners, cross-industry (fintech, health, platform infra). Need help: sourcing, outreach templates, and acceptance criteria. 
Alex (Design): +1. I'd prioritize platform infra and mid-market fintech. They give fastest signal on latency/cost tradeoffs.
Priya (SRE/SE): Can we require a 2-week integration window? we need logs and perf traces to run our batching/kv cache experiments.
Maria (PM): Yes — acceptance criteria we discussed: onboarding script run within 2 weeks, at least 500 inference minutes in first month, and 80% feedback response rate to the evaluation prompts.
Sam (Eng PM): Also add rollback criteria: if average p95 latency > 2.5x baseline or error rate spike > 3% for 1h, auto-fallback to hosted variant.
Jordan (CSE): I can surface 3 candidates from current pilot customers. I'll prep a short one-pager for them.
Li (Sales): I have 6 inbound leads that match. Need an outreach snippet and credit/incentive language.
Carla (Growth): Proposed incentive: $5k platform credits + dedicated onboarding support. Also offer early access to performance dashboard. Thoughts? :sparkles: 
Alex (Design): Sounds fair. Add a non-disclosure checkbox and a brief privacy/PII handling note.
Maria (PM): Outreach snippet draft (base): 
```
Hi <name>, we're recruiting a small set of partners to test Redwood Dedicated for production inference. We'll provide onboarding support, $5k credits, and a direct channel to engineering. In return we ask for integration telemetry, 2 scheduled feedback sessions, and prompt sets for eval. Interested?
```

Priya (SRE/SE): Add a link to the data handling doc and ask for expected qps/seq length in the reply.
Li (Sales): I'll A/B test subject lines. If anyone has referral hooks (legal/compliance champions) ping me.
Jordan (CSE): For success metrics, propose: activation < 14 days, retention (active inference days) >= 60% in month 1, and 75% of flagged regressions triaged within 72h.
Sam (Eng PM): Let's make triage SLA 48h for severity P0/P1. Other issues can be 72–120h.
Carla (Growth): How do we capture structured feedback? CSV? google form? We should make a small NPS + 5 targeted questions plus a free-text box.
Maria (PM): Agree. We'll push a lightweight form + a short auto-eval harness. Priya — can you provide the perf telemetry fields schema?
Priya (SRE/SE): I'll drop the schema in the tracker. For now include: model_version, seq_len_p50/p95, p50/p95 latency, error_count, tokens_served, batch_size_distribution.
recruiter-bot: New candidate added: Acme Platform (contact: rachel@acme). Status: inbound lead.
Li (Sales): Adding Acme to the outreach list.
Alex (Design): Suggest we reserve 2 slots for high-touch enterprise and 2 for scrappier startups — gives diverse signal.
Maria (PM): Good call. Action items: Jordan/ Li — deliver candidate list by EOD Thu. Priya — perf schema + onboarding checklist by Fri. Carla — outreach A/B snippets and survey by Fri. Sam — confirm rollback automation playbook Monday.
Jordan (CSE): Will do.
Li (Sales): On it.
Priya (SRE/SE): ETA Fri morning.
Carla (Growth): I'll draft 3 subject lines and the form.
Sam (Eng PM): I'll run the automation doc with eng-runtime this week.
Maria (PM): Thanks everyone — we'll reconvene Tue 11am to finalize the acceptance matrix. :thumbsup:
